RISK! Podcast Directory

A Screen-Reader-Friendly Guide to the Archived Storytelling Show

Jamal Mazrui

September 2026

Abstract

A browsable directory of the RISK! podcast, the true-storytelling show created and hosted by Kevin Allison. It covers the full archive of 1285 episodes, from 2009 to 2026. Each episode heading links to its page on the RISK! website, and its metadata is broken into separate, alphabetically sorted fields: date, series, stories, storytellers, songs, and musicians, or a summary when that is what the episode carries. Three appendixes reorder episodes by date, by title, and by storyteller.

RISK! Podcast Directory

RISK! is a live show and weekly podcast where people tell true stories they never thought they would dare to share in public. It was created and hosted by Kevin Allison, who came up through the sketch group The State. The live show began in 2009, and the podcast followed in October of that year. New story episodes arrive on Mondays, and a classic episode from the early years arrives each Thursday. The show has won an ECNY Award for Best Podcast and draws over a million downloads a month.

This directory covers the full archive: 1285 episodes, from 2009 through 2026, featuring more than 1332 storytellers. Every episode is a heading that links to its page on the RISK! website. You can listen from any of those pages, or subscribe through Apple Podcasts or Spotify.

Each episode lists the metadata on record, one kind per field, and every field appears only when that information is available. The fields, in the order they appear, are: Contents, a raw credit list kept whole when it could not be split cleanly; Date, the day it was published; Music credits, an older episode’s music credits kept verbatim when they could not be split; Musicians, the artists heard in the episode; Series, the named series it belongs to; Songs, the music tracks and interstitials; Stories, the individual story titles; Storytellers, the people who told them; and Summary, a short description when the episode carries one instead of a credit list. Story titles and song titles are sorted by title, ignoring a leading “A”, “An”, or “The”; people are sorted by surname; all sorting ignores case. Storyteller names have been merged so that a person who was credited under more than one spelling now appears under a single best spelling.

Episodes are grouped into the categories below by kind, and within each category they are listed in order by title. Three appendixes offer other orders: by date, by title, and by storyteller. A note on content: RISK! is known for frank, adult storytelling, and many episodes deal openly with sex, drugs, trauma, and other mature themes.

The show and its episode pages are the work of Kevin Allison and the RISK! team. This directory was compiled by Jamal Mazrui from the show’s public archive; for current details, the linked pages are authoritative.
